capture_runner.replay: copy/replay validates local compact receipts and tooling while raw profiles stay external
capture_runner.requires: frozen native comparison manifest with exact baseline/candidate binary, build receipt, and source receipt bindings

fail_closed: per-allocation-index live counts reject invalid double free
missing strings/ips terminal summaries reject truncation
zstdcat process is closed and reaped on parse errors

performance_claim: allocation counts, requested bytes, and heaptrack peak heap only; no native latency claim
purpose: whole-process allocation diagnosis for the owned-source fingerprint comparison

raw_artifacts.retention: all raw .zst profiles, heaptrack_print stdout/stderr, histogram, process-time log, harness report, and child receipt remain outside the repository
raw_artifacts.size_and_hash: each retained raw and derived artifact records byte size and SHA-256

limits: Heaptrack overhead is included in the recorded process profile and can affect profile-time behavior.
The results are allocation diagnostics, not operation peak-live memory, native latency, CPU cycles, or adoption evidence.
Heaptrack peak heap is a whole-process live-allocation peak, not the timed harness lifecycle boundary.
The 24-child lane is supplemental whole-process allocation evidence; it does not isolate the selected edit operation.
scope.parser_filter: none; every allocation (+) and deallocation (-) event in the interpreted profile contributes
scope.profile: whole process, including setup, warmup-free lifecycle, correctness/oracle work, report serialization, and teardown allocations recorded by Heaptrack

source_and_binary_binding.binary_reuse: use the same frozen 0923 native baseline and candidate executables; no rebuild, alternate binary, or source fallback
source_and_binary_binding.harness: same frozen native harness and route environment
source_and_binary_binding.native_manifest: the frozen comparison-manifest-v2.json is the sole source for baseline/candidate binary paths and SHA-256 values

validation.before_capture: allocation-parse-v2.py parses all six retained 0919 profiles; heaptrack_print totals and decimal-rounded peak are checked for every profile in allocation-parser-validation.json; parser negative controls are recorded in allocation-parser-controls-v2.json
fail_closed: reject unknown Heaptrack format versions or record tags
reject deallocation underflow or nonzero parser failure
reject missing raw profile, report, print output, histogram, time log, or descriptor
reject any child with nonzero capture or analysis exit status
reject a native manifest that is dry-run, lacks candidate source/build identity, or has changed binary hashes
reject an allocation capture without explicit approval, with an existing state/child output, or with incomplete 24-child schedule
reject parser/heaptrack_print allocation-call, live/leaked-byte, or rounded-peak disagreement
